components.name: Parent
components.doc:
Parent attaches its entity to Entity. The entity also needs a
gfx.Transform: the [System] overwrites it each tick with the world
transform computed from the parent chain, so a serialized Transform of a
child is derived data. Use [Attach] from code.

Entity.description:
Entity is the parent. In a GOD level it is the id of an object of the
same document.

Local.description: Local is the placement relative to the parent.

LayerMode.description: LayerMode says how the child's layers follow the parent's.

x-enum.name: LayerRelative
x-enum.doc:
LayerRelative sets the child's layers to the parent's layer plus
[Local.LayerOffset] every tick.

x-enum.name: LayerAbsolute
x-enum.doc: LayerAbsolute leaves the child's layers alone.

LayerOffset.description: LayerOffset is added to the parent's layer with LayerRelative.

Pos.description:
Pos is the offset in the parent's space: scaled and rotated by the
parent's world Scale and Rot.

Rot.description:
Rot is added to the parent's rotation, in radians. Under a mirrored
parent (one negative scale axis) it is subtracted.

Scale.description: Scale multiplies the parent's scale. Zero means (1, 1).

YSortSide.description:
YSortSide says where the child sorts relative to its root in a
Y-sorted layer.

x-enum.name: YSortInFront
x-enum.doc: YSortInFront sorts the child just in front of its root.

x-enum.name: YSortBehind
x-enum.doc: YSortBehind sorts the child just behind its root.
